source.what: FlowSpace location detail page (flowspace.framer.website/locations/tuileries): a single-location page under the FlowSpace coworking template. Breadcrumb plus H1 and address over a dominant-plus-quadrant photo cluster, a sticky black enquiry form riding the right rail, an anchor tab row over three stacked sections (Spaces, Services, Access), a dark scrim photo card row for other locations, and the black footer. Monochrome UI, one family throughout, no accent hue.
source.method: Node + puppeteer-core driving local Chromium (ms-playwright build). Loaded at 1440x900, 834x1112, 390x844; scrolled the full page to trigger every entrance, then advanced all running animations to their end state via document.getAnimations() finish+commitStyles so every still is settled. Full-page and fold stills per width. Computed-style probes on H1, section headings, breadcrumb, tabs, body, stat chips, space cards, service rows, location cards and their scrims, the enquiry form (card, labels, input wrappers, select, textarea, submit), nav and footer. Hover probes on nav links and submit button. Scroll probes at five offsets for the sticky form and the fixed nav. Full page text export.
gaps: Hover states are only partly known. The nav link fades black to rgba(82,82,82,0.8) and the submit button was probed with no computed change. The nav CTA pill, the space cards and the location-card View pill could not be reached by the hover machinery (the picker resolved a hidden zero-size node ahead of the visible one), so their hover behaviour is unknown.

The anchor tab row is present with an active underline under Overview, but clicking a tab did not move the page in the probe; whether these tabs scroll to the sections, swap panel content, or are inert in the template is unresolved. Section headings exist for Spaces, Services and Access, so the anchors have plausible targets.

The 'Access' section contains the enquiry form only. In the visible column at desktop the section heading is followed by whitespace down to the Other-locations band; the form lives in the right rail, so the section reads as heading + empty column once the sticky form has scrolled away.
One long (10s, 5s delay) opacity fade is registered on a container in the animation timeline on every load; its purpose was not resolved and it had completed before measurement.
Several wrapper nodes compute the default link blue rgb(0,0,238) without rendering blue; the visible pills inherit no blue. Treated as not part of the design, as on the home page.

DM Sans and Inter load with the document but were not observed rendering any visible text; only Plus Jakarta Sans was seen. The rendered-size census returns only sizes up to 20px for body text, so H1 and heading sizes were read from the element itself rather than the census.
The hero image cluster is a carousel or gallery in the template's live behaviour; only its settled state is captured. Its drag or arrow affordance, if any, was not exercised.
The form is a demo: select options are Book a tour / Ask a question / Partnership / Something else, and no submission endpoint was exercised.
On mobile the stat chips wrap to two rows, which displaces the following section; the exact wrap breakpoints between 390 and 834 were not measured.
Template content is placeholder (demo address, hello@yourcoworking.com, +33 6 12 34 56 78) and would differ in a real deployment.
source.notes: Sibling to flowspace_home_v1 (the template's home page). Both are pages of the same template; they share nav, footer, type scale, pill system and card radius. Where this page's evidence differs from the home page it is because the page is a detail template, not a landing page: no marquee strips, no plan inversion, no FAQ, no full-bleed hero. The sticky form is the page's structural signature and is absent from the home page.

parts.name: Sticky enquiry form on the right rail
parts.description: A black enquiry card sits in the right rail of the content grid and pins at top 84px while the left column scrolls through Spaces, Services and Access. It is the page's only dark mass above the footer and the only interactive surface on the page. Measured: the form computes position sticky with top 84px on a FORM element inside the Content block; at scroll 0 it sits at viewport y 762, at scroll 1200 it has pinned to y 104, and it releases upward once the left column ends (y -370 at scroll 1900). The card is 377px wide in a 1120px container, 16px radius, 20px padding.
parts.entry_test: Remove the stickiness and the page becomes a one-column list of facts with a form parked at the bottom. The form riding alongside the content is what makes this page a booking page rather than a description page, and the black card against the white column is the page's one structural contrast.
parts.recipe: Lay the content block out as two columns inside the 1120px container: a flexible left column carrying tabs, paragraphs, cards and lists, and a fixed 377px right rail. Place the black card in the rail with position: sticky; top: 84px. Give the card background #000, radius 16px, padding 20px. The rail must be as tall as the left column or the pin releases early.

parts.name: One-plus-quadrant photo cluster
parts.description: The page is headed by five photographs arranged as one dominant landscape frame plus a 2x2 grid of squares to its right, rather than a single hero. Measured: the lead image is 667x440 at x160 y278; the four tiles are 214x214 at x839/x1066 and y278/y504. The gutters are 12px both ways and every frame carries the same 16px radius. The cluster reads as a gallery that has been given a hierarchy instead of a carousel strip.
parts.entry_test: Replace the cluster with one wide hero and the page loses its claim to showing the room from several angles without spending five full-width bands on it. The asymmetric 1+4 packing is the page's opening identity, and the lead frame's 667x440 box is what makes the four squares read as a supporting set.

limitations: Hover states are only partly known: nav links fade to rgba(82,82,82,0.8) and the submit button showed no computed change; the nav CTA pill, the space cards and the location-card View pill were unreachable by the hover probe (a hidden zero-size node resolved ahead of the visible one), so their hover behaviour is unverified.

The anchor tab row renders with an active underline but clicking a tab did not move the page in the probe. Whether the tabs scroll, swap panels, or are inert in the template is unresolved; Spaces, Services and Access exist as section headings, so plausible targets exist.

The Access section contains the enquiry form only, and the form lives in the right rail. In the left column the heading is followed by whitespace down to the Other-locations band, so the section reads as heading plus empty column once the sticky card has scrolled past.
One 10s opacity fade with a 5s delay is registered on a container on every load; its purpose was not resolved and it had completed before measurement.
Several wrapper nodes compute the default link blue rgb(0,0,238) without rendering blue; this matches the home page and is treated as not part of the design.

DM Sans and Inter load with the document but render no visible text; only Plus Jakarta Sans was observed. Body-text sizes above 20px were read from the elements themselves, since the rendered-size census only returns sizes up to 20px.
The header photo cluster behaves as a gallery or carousel in the template's live state; only the settled arrangement is captured and any drag or arrow affordance was not exercised.
The enquiry form is a demo: it has four select options and no submission endpoint was exercised. Its valid/invalid and error states are uncaptured.
Mobile stat chips wrap to two rows, displacing the following section; the exact wrap breakpoints between 390 and 834 were not measured.

The residual gaps on the sibling home page rubric apply here too wherever the two pages share a component: nav scroll reveal, the marquee-free detail template has no motion to characterise, and the footer link hover was not re-probed on this page.
